risks: Resident tabs increase steady-state renderer memory.
Preloading every visible tab at once could cause startup jank.
Hidden mounted panels could keep side effects alive if child components are not gated.
controls: Resident sections are scheduled one by one through requestIdleCallback or short timeout fallback.
Hidden panels use hidden and aria-hidden.
Mounted panels use CSS contain: layout paint style.
Desktop/source runtime launchRequest and surfaceActive are gated to the active section.
cleanup_paths: Idle callback handles are canceled on effect cleanup when supported.
Timeout handles are cleared on effect cleanup.
validation_results: in-app Browser DOM resident check was inconclusive because the page stayed on Loading workspace snapshot
